text: Detail pass 2026-11-06: art off the pixel grid, panels at twice the size, ring gap, bar numbers fit, second power bar, tail with a line. Needs a game run; themeshots now logs textfit lines.
Four shape themes (Crimson Vanguard, Hearthside, Cathedral, Runestone): masks on real bars and portraits need a game run.
Nameplates and cast bars stay square: the game's own art sits around them.
New ice corner art: needs a game look on Frostbound.
Still unstyled: bags, swing timer, quest objectives, minimap, buffs, combat text, chat.
Raid frames look nearly alike across themes now: only the border differs.
Chat bubble tail looks detached in most themes.
Corner art: some still looks basic. Class-themed art not started.
Zone card overlaps chat: in its own session.
Tooltip words hidden behind the panel.
Vertical streaks and hard bands on tall raid tiles.
Nameplates ignored themes (friendly plates in dungeons still can't be reached).

Party role icons hidden by themes.
